static void lofi_note_on(track_t *t, voice_t *v)
{
    v->s[0] = 0;                 /* held sample */
    v->s[1] = 0;                 /* hold counter */
    v->s[2] = 0x7FFF;            /* LFSR */
    v->s[3] = 0;                 /* sweep, 1/16 st */
    v->s[4] = 0;                 /* 1-pole lp state */
    v->s[5] = 0;                 /* arp counter */
    v->s[6] = 15 | (step_period(t->p[P_E3] >> 2) & 15) << 4;   /* stepped env: every note-on restarts it */
    v->s[7] = 0;
}
